ADDR Change home address
BANK Change bank details
LTR Employment verification letter
LV-BOOK Book or correct a leave booking
TAX Change a tax form or withholding
ACC HartwellOne access or password
PAY-DISP Dispute about pay owed
ACCOM Accommodation or adjustment
CONC Concern, complaint or grievance
LV-EXC Leave outside policy or protected leave
RTW Right to work or visa
CHASE Chasing an earlier request
PAY-ERR Pay wrong because a process failed
REWORK Resubmitting a form that bounced
ONB-MISS New starter item missing

sensitive: true if the text mentions the person's health,
pregnancy, disability, conduct by or toward them, harassment,
safety, a protected characteristic, or immigration status.
chasing: true if the person is following up an earlier request.

"chasing": false}]
